description: This Java class implements a builder pattern for constructing instances of VisitSearchCriteria used in querying visit records within the OpenMRS healthcare management system. It provides a flexible interface to set various filters such as visit types, patients, locations, dates, and other attributes.

classes.name: VisitSearchCriteriaBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of VisitSearchCriteria with various filter options.

methods.name: visitTypes
methods.description: Sets the collection of VisitType objects for filtering visits.

methods.name: patients
methods.description: Sets the collection of Patient objects for filtering visits.

methods.name: patient
methods.description: Sets a single Patient object for filtering visits.

methods.name: locations
methods.description: Sets the collection of Location objects for filtering visits.

methods.name: indications
methods.description: Sets the collection of Concept objects representing indications for filtering visits.

methods.name: minStartDatetime
methods.description: Sets the minimum start date filter for visits.

methods.name: maxStartDatetime
methods.description: Sets the maximum start date filter for visits.

methods.name: minEndDatetime
methods.description: Sets the minimum end date filter for visits.

methods.name: maxEndDatetime
methods.description: Sets the maximum end date filter for visits.

methods.name: serializedAttributeValues
methods.description: Sets serialized attribute values for visit filtering based on VisitAttributeType.

methods.name: includeInactive
methods.description: Sets whether inactive visits should be included.

methods.name: includeVoided
methods.description: Sets whether voided visits should be included.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns an instance of VisitSearchCriteria with the configured filters.
